2026_02_JAX_DEN.headline: Denver gets an immediate rematch with confident Jacksonville
2026_02_JAX_DEN.paragraph1: Denver’s home opener brings an immediate rematch with Jacksonville after the Jaguars ended the Broncos’ long winning streak in Denver last season. Jacksonville’s schedule breakdown recalls Trevor Lawrence throwing four touchdowns in that victory, while Denver’s preview points to Travis Hunter’s expected return as a major personnel change for the rematch. The Broncos need to keep Lawrence from settling into rhythm again; the Jaguars need to prove last season’s explosive passing success can travel into a new game plan.
2026_02_JAX_DEN.model_rationale: Denver’s ability to disrupt Trevor Lawrence before Jacksonville creates explosive passes determines whether the Broncos can turn last season’s loss into a different kind of game.
